requirements.existing_boundary: Published question contrasts area-derived fitting accounting with a whole-hull manifest and asks which physical joints support the allowance.
prospective_record_requirements: Original source/domain/revision and exact clamp/pad/joint accounting definitions, question custody and comparison scope
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Neither bill quantity nor symbol census supplies a completed physical manifest. No source count/area/mass values copied or calculated.

requirements.existing_boundary: Clamps are area-derived accounting and GridClamps is a patch-only drawing counterpart.
prospective_record_requirements: Original count definition and applicability, source bill versus local depiction correspondence and explicit completeness limits, actual installation record only when supplied
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: A local patch or rendering segment cannot supply whole-hull population; no scaling, counting, selected clamp or fastener.

requirements.existing_boundary: Pads are a bill label with no drawn counterpart and no complete drawn allocation.
prospective_record_requirements: Original pad count/inclusion conventions, source representation gap and applicable actual installation/manifest correspondence when supplied
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: No drawing is not physical absence; unknown counterpart is not zero or a selected pad count/design.

requirements.existing_boundary: Source joint allowance has patch-only symbols and no complete allocation; record/favourable bill worlds remain source labels.
prospective_record_requirements: Original allowance definition/domain/revision and physical-joint identities supporting it when supplied, bill/manifest correspondence and missing or unmatched records
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: An allowance is not actual joint mass, complete installed inventory or chosen section/load path. No pricing or source mass recomputation.

requirements.existing_boundary: Complete actual fitting/joint manifest, configuration and installation are unsupplied.
prospective_record_requirements: Original responsible manifest/source/configuration/revision, physical joint/fitting identity and installation custody, inclusion/exclusion/deduplication and coverage conventions
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Do not fill incomplete records from generic outfit symbols, partial fittings or other allowance maps. No completed manifest, selected connection/geometry/material or procedure invented.

requirements.existing_boundary: No actual raw installation/count/manifest acquisition/calibration/uncertainty record establishes applicability.
prospective_record_requirements: Unmodified raw source/installation/manifest identities, revision/custody, applicable calibration/uncertainty and matched comparison records
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Source generation or software checks cannot supply measured completeness, calibrated quantities or physical applicability; no uncertainty/count estimate.

requirements.existing_boundary: Custodian roles are proposals and actual manifest/adoption source unknown.
prospective_record_requirements: Responsible source/custody role, adopted manifest/count-definition/criterion version/domain/applicability only when supplied
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: No physical-joint selection, adopted inventory, criterion, feasibility or qualification follows from this paper map.
